doc: Platform user. The User Master is identified by UUID matching METRI_MASTER_USER_ID (env var) — NOT by any mutable database flag. Its credentials (password_hash) are seeded from environment variables at bootstrap.

attributes.name: password_hash
attributes.doc: Bcrypt/Argon2 hash. Never stored in plaintext. Populated at bootstrap from METRI_MASTER_USER_PASSWORD_HASH (env var) for the User Master only. Normal users authenticate via external IdP — this field is null for them.

attributes.name: role_ids
attributes.doc: Reference to the User's authorization roles (Matrix dimension).

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.doc: Mandatory tenant isolation for identity management.
